title: The Robbers Take the Desolate Lands
summary: In the latter end of the eighteenth year, the robber armies emerged from their strongholds and took possession of lands and deserted cities. The lands had no game; game remained only in the wilderness.

explicit_facts.text: In the latter end of the eighteenth year, the robber armies emerged from hills, mountains, wilderness, strongholds, and secret places, then took possession of deserted lands and cities.
The deserted lands had no wild beasts or game; the robbers could find game only in the wilderness.

title: The Nephites Gather Provisions
summary: The Nephites had gathered their flocks, herds, and substance into one body and reserved provisions and animals to sustain themselves for seven years, hoping to destroy the robbers. The robbers could obtain food only by open battle.

explicit_facts.text: The Nephites gathered their flocks, herds, and substance and were in one body.

The robbers had no opportunity to plunder or obtain food except by open battle against the Nephites.

explicit_facts.text: In the nineteenth year, Giddianhi found that his people could subsist only by plundering, robbing, and murdering.
The robbers did not spread across the land to raise grain because they feared the Nephites would attack them.
Giddianhi commanded his armies to go to battle against the Nephites that year.

title: Zemnarihah's Siege
summary: In the twenty-first year, the robbers came from all sides and laid siege around the people of Nephi. Zemnarihah, their newly appointed leader, caused the siege.

explicit_facts.text: In the twenty-first year the robbers surrounded the people of Nephi in a siege, seeking to cut them off from their lands and privileges and force their surrender.

summary: The Nephites had ample stored provisions, while the robbers had only meat obtained in the wilderness. As wild game became scarce, the robbers neared death from hunger.
